description: `Cls(...)` in a `case`: checks `isinstance(subject, Cls)`, then matches attributes. It never constructs an object.
A class attribute tuple of attribute names that gives meaning to positional sub-patterns: position 1 reads the first name, and so on.
`Cls(attr=pattern)`: reads `subject.attr` by name; works on any class, with or without `__match_args__`.
`@dataclass` creates it from the non-keyword-only `__init__` parameters, in field order, unless the class defines its own.
`int(n)`, `str(s)`, `float(f)` and the other listed built-ins match their single positional sub-pattern against the whole subject.
